summary: Real-code evidence for bounded transcript segmentation (Part A) and the Live Intelligence Router (Part B), plus direct compiled-binary proof.
trigger: The operator's own two-part design following Phase 3.8.7.4's audit: (A) stop treating Whisper's ~3s buffering window as the unit of persistence/analysis - accumulate into bounded 12-20s logical segments instead, and (B) route each completed segment through Bible, Sermon, Service Phase, Prayer/Worship (via Sermon/Service's own internal detection), and Music-text, reusing each engine's already-tested analyze_and_queue unchanged.

partA_segmentation.newModule: apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/segmentation.rs - TranscriptSegmenter, deliberately Tauri-agnostic, owned exclusively by one spawn_speech_worker thread per listening session (mirrors acoustic::AcousticWorkerState's ownership pattern).
partA_segmentation.windowDesign: Concatenates consecutive raw Whisper-window segments' text until the accumulated span reaches a 15s target (the middle of the operator's 12-20s band); given Whisper's fixed ~3.0s emission cadence (CHUNK_SAMPLES, unchanged), this lands segments between 15s and ~18s in practice.
partA_segmentation.deliberatelyNotImplemented: Pause/silence-based early flushing - confirmed by re-reading ai/speech/src/whisper.rs fresh this phase that feed_audio triggers run_inference() purely on buffer.len() >= CHUNK_SAMPLES, with no VAD/silence signal anywhere. Inventing one would be guessing at a boundary CIP cannot detect - explicitly deferred as a distinct, larger future design needing new audio-layer evidence.
partA_segmentation.overloadInteraction: spawn_speech_worker's existing Phase 3.8.7.3 overload-drain branch now also calls segmenter.reset() alongside SpeechEngine::discard_buffered_audio(), preventing pre-overload accumulated text from being spliced onto unrelated post-recovery text - the same discontinuous-buffer problem discard_buffered_audio prevents one layer down.
partA_segmentation.stopMidWindow: spawn_speech_worker's loop, on channel closure (stop_listening), now calls segmenter.flush_remaining() and routes any real partial-window text through the same finalize_and_route_segment path (generation-checked) - previously a sub-threshold Whisper buffer was simply lost on stop; at the new coarser 12-20s grain this would otherwise discard far more real speech.

partB_router.insertionPoint: commands.rs::route_segment_to_live_intelligence_engines, called from the new finalize_and_route_segment (shared by handle_audio_chunk's normal flush and spawn_speech_worker's stop-mid-window flush) immediately after handle_final_transcript succeeds - the exact insertion point Phase 3.8.7.4's audit identified.
partB_router.contextReuse: Builds one IntelligenceContext via the existing build_music_context and reuses it for Sermon/Service/Music, rather than each rebuilding/re-locking it independently like three separate manual commands would.
partB_router.sermonRouting: route_segment_to_sermon calls crate::sermon::analyze_and_queue against AppState.sermon_engine unchanged, mirroring analyze_sermon_transcript's post-context logic exactly (same SermonFindingDetected/SermonStateChanged/SermonThemeChanged/SermonStructureUpdated event emissions, snapshot-diffing). Covers Prayer detection for free - PrayerPoint is a SermonElementKind this engine already detects internally, confirmed in Phase 3.8.7.4's audit.
partB_router.serviceRouting: route_segment_to_service calls crate::service::analyze_and_queue against AppState.service_engine unchanged, mirroring analyze_service_transcript's post-context logic exactly (same ServicePhaseChanged/ServiceAnomalyDetected event emissions and timeline records). Covers Worship detection for free - ServicePhase::Worship is a phase this engine already detects internally.
partB_router.musicTextRouting: route_segment_to_music_text resolves the registry's Music engine and calls music::analyze_and_queue unchanged, mirroring analyze_music_transcript's post-context logic exactly. Included because Phase 3.8.7.4's audit found this exact engine already built to accept arbitrary transcript text safely - its own distinctiveness/confidence gating already returns zero findings for non-lyric prose.
partB_router.deliberatelyExcluded: Cross-Domain Correlation and Content Intelligence - both explicitly documented in their own doc comments as 'an explicit operator/diagnostic action, never triggered automatically by a transcript segment arriving,' a considered Phase 2.4/2.7/2.8 design decision this router does not reverse. Automatic Altar Call detection - SermonSectionKind::AltarCall exists only as an operator-assignable label with no phrase detector (Phase 3.8.7.4 Finding); there is no engine to route to.
partB_router.noNewEngineLogic: Every analyze_and_queue call, event name, and timeline record shape is copied verbatim from the corresponding manual command - the router adds a new caller, not new domain logic, no new database schema, no new event contracts, no new Tauri commands.

directCompiledBinaryProof.buildCommitEmbedded: '88a60b2ac17c' found verbatim - the real baseline commit (Phase 3.8.7.4) this build was made against
directCompiledBinaryProof.inlinedAsExpected: route_segment_to_live_intelligence_engines and its three per-domain helpers (route_segment_to_sermon/service/music_text) were inlined by the release-mode optimizer - each has exactly one call site, the classic case LLVM inlines. Expected, not a gap; their behavior is verified via the full regression suite and via being byte-identical copies of each manual command's already-tested logic.
